cases.invariant: A command made only of read-only programs is not a write of the files it reads, even when it names a write word
cases.actor: Opus approver or any session running read-only commands
cases.input: read-only grep, grep plus sed -n, Select-String, grep with a quoted redirection, git diff, sed -n range and Get-Content piped to Select-String, each naming governance scope files and write words
cases.response: isReadOnlyShellCommand true, shellWriteTargets empty, governanceIndependenceErrors empty
forbiddenEffects: an independent approver refused for a command that only read files
a read file reported as written
cases.testName: [GOV-941-HOOK-READONLY-ALLOW] A command made only of read-only programs is not a write of the files it reads, even when it names a write word

cases.invariant: Every real shell write of a governance scope file is still counted, including one chained after a read-only command
cases.input: variants: Set-Content, node -e writeFileSync, echo redirection, grep redirected into the file, grep then node -e writeFileSync, grep and Set-Content, Get-Content piped to Set-Content, rg --pre with a write word; revision 1: a write hidden after a Bash # comment, a PowerShell # comment and a PowerShell block comment that contain a quote
cases.response: the written file among the targets and a GOVERNANCE INDEPENDENCE error for it
forbiddenEffects: an implementing session approving its own governance change
a write hidden behind a read-only first command
cases.testName: [GOV-941-HOOK-WRITE-DENY] Every real shell write of a governance scope file is still counted, including one chained after a read-only command

cases.invariant: A command that cannot be classified safely keeps the previous fail-closed detection
cases.input: unterminated quote, backtick, command substitution, process substitution and heredoc, each naming a scope file with a write word; a non-string command; revision 1: an unquoted #, Bash $'...' and $"..." quoting, a backslash-spelled rg --pre and git --output, an unquoted glob in sed and rg arguments, and a double-quoted $_ argument of rg, git and sed
cases.response: isReadOnlyShellCommand false and shellWriteTargets equal to the pre-change detection
forbiddenEffects: an exception instead of a result
cases.testName: [GOV-941-HOOK-MALFORMED-ERROR] A command that cannot be classified safely keeps the previous fail-closed detection

cases.invariant: The pre-write guard allows a read-only search of a policy file and still refuses a chained policy write
cases.input: executor PowerShell event: Select-String for Set-Content in scripts/check-example.mjs; the same search followed by Set-Content on that file; revision 1: executor Bash events with a redirection into that file or into .git/hooks/pre-commit hidden after a # comment that contains a quote
cases.response: empty error list for the search; POLICY-EDIT AUTHORITY REQUIRED for the chained and the comment-hidden policy write; OWNER GIT REQUIRED for the comment-hidden Git metadata write
forbiddenEffects: Sonnet writing a policy file through a chained command
a read-only search refused as a policy edit
cases.testName: [GOV-941-HOOK-PRETOOL-DENY] The pre-write guard allows a read-only search of a policy file and still refuses a chained policy write

cases.invariant: CI refuses a change to the hook file outside every changed governance contract scope
cases.input: fixture root whose diff changes scripts/workflow-gates/security-hook.mjs with no governance contract
cases.response: outside every changed governance contract scope
forbiddenEffects: a hook change reaching main without a governance contract
cases.testName: [GOV-941-CI-POLICY-DENY] CI refuses a change to the hook file outside every changed governance contract scope
